notes.note: Two solid scores in a row for Cumming but trusting him on the ground in this Tigers outfit is a risky business. A great loop option though.
Cumming was solid this week with his 19 disposals. This was his best in the last three weeks. A good bench cover as he is putting up some decent scores.
Cumming kicked a couple of goals but without that his score may have been quite low. Use him as bench cover.
Just 3 of Cumming's 15 touches were kicks as we saw his lowest score since round 10.
Best two week run for the season for Cumming with his 27 disposals this week. A solid player to keep in your roster on the bench.
Cumming posted his best for the season as he kicked a goal from his 18 disposals. He is ok as bench cover for you.
Cumming has been over 60 in his last three now and has a BE of 36. He is one of the Tigers that you could hold for one more week but not much more than that.
Two good scores in a row from Cumming and although not big it is enough to keep his cash generation going and also put up some points for us during these difficult rounds.
17 disposals and a goal for Cumming. This meant that he got past his BE of 63 and he has a new BE of 25. He could be held still til his bye of R13.
Cumming had just 13 disposals as he made his BE but his new one is 63 which is rising faster than we had hoped. He is one you can trade out.
Cumming couldn't back up his great start to his career as he was held to just 8 disposals this week. He went at 87% but his BE has now risen sharply to 17.
Cumming's second game netted 23 points and 6 tackles. He will be an incredibly popular trade in this week.
Cumming showed on debut that he is every bit the scorer we thought he was going to be with 5 clearances and 8 contested possessions with his 13 touches. Give him one more week before bringing him in.
Cumming will out til round 5 at least with a shoulder injury
